card.name: Linking words before process nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, to, the, in, including) that come just before a noun for a biological process, such as inhibition, degradation, formation, or treatment. They appear in warnings and adverse-reaction text.

modes.label: of/to/the before mechanism
modes.description: Linking word right before a degradation or inhibition phrase in a mechanism explanation.
modes.example: Presumably due to the inhibition<< of>> the degradation of endogenous bradykin

modes.label: the/in before outcome
modes.description: Linking word before a result noun such as formation or symptoms.
modes.example: may result in<< the>> formation of autoantibodies and in
